Akshan.escape: The moment Akshan uses Akshan E Heroic Swing is LeBlanc's window to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before going in, check that the return point is safe, and don't miss the recast window for LeBlanc W Distortion, so Akshan can't retaliate for long.
Akshan.phase: Later, if LeBlanc can't kill a target in one burst, she becomes vulnerable to retaliation, so prioritize chances to pick off enemies moving alone.
Akshan.teamfight: LeBlanc shouldn't engage first from the front. Wait until the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then target one enemy from the side and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Akshan has a Scoundrel mark, don't face him alone or fight within Akshan's execute range. Before a teamfight, look for a chance to bind and pick off an enemy moving alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical, and LeBlanc has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, buy Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: Once Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, when the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If you need another root, cast LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic the chain.
Akshan.fight: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion for a short trade. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits, stay within chain range until the root lands, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to escape before taking prolonged retaliation.
Akshan.laning: After that, farm while dodging the outbound and return paths of Akshan Q Avengerang. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push, then roam; if you can't push, don't leave your lane.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so stand behind minions to avoid being hit and dodge its return path too. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to move, and its cooldown resets when he gets a takedown, so be careful not to give him a kill. If Akshan R Comeuppance marks you for execution while your health is low, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone through an open area.

Anivia.teamfight: Fight in a wide lane rather than a narrow path where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Don't engage first from the front; after the fight starts, target one enemy in the backline from the side, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to bind and pick off an enemy moving alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Anivia.laning: To make sure you break the egg, attack with an ally. When roaming, push the lane first; if you can't push, don't leave your lane.
Anivia.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Anivia.combo: If Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay within chain range.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion during the window when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Before going in, check that the return point is safe; if Anivia still has a counterattack ability, don't miss the return window for LeBlanc W Distortion and escape.
Anivia.fight: Trade briefly right after Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion to deal damage, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to escape before Anivia's counterattack abilities come back up.
Anivia.phase: Later, the enemy's magic resistance and vision make it harder to kill a target in one burst, so avoid forced engages.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes when recast and stuns, so don't just sidestep the projectile; also account for the explosion point. If it hits you or you are inside a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so escape the storm immediately with LeBlanc W Distortion. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia's damage over time is strong in the late game, and it becomes harder for LeBlanc to finish a target in one burst, so pick off enemies who are alone on paths without vision.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then approach from the side. If Cassiopeia W Miasma was used elsewhere, catch someone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic and target one enemy. Use LeBlanc W Distortion to get out after attacking.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia's main damage is magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so increase your magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Cassiopeia.combo: When Cassiopeia W Miasma is down, hit Cassiopeia with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, as the chain connects and roots her, detonate the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. Keep the right distance while the chain is connected, and recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return after attacking.
Cassiopeia.escape: Engage during a window when Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze are down. If the cloud is already on the ground, go around it instead of pressing LeBlanc W Distortion while inside it. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hit you, delay your engage until the poison ends.
Cassiopeia.fight: As soon as Cassiopeia W Miasma is down, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal brief damage, and return. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hit you, fight again after the poison ends. Check that LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe before going in.
Cassiopeia.laning: Push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you have not pushed, do not leave your position.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more, so move out of range until the poison ends. You cannot use LeBlanc W Distortion inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so stay out of the cloud. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid the stun.

Ekko.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then choose a target and approach from the side. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive brings him in, look for a root with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic, then get out with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch and pick off an enemy who is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Ekko.laning: Avoid trading blows before the enemy's key abilities are down. Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast it to return, repeating these brief trades. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave your position.
Ekko.phase: Build magic resistance early and trade briefly only when the enemy's key abilities are down. In the late game, avoid risky engages because you can be counterattacked if you fail to kill the target in one burst.
Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko's damage is mostly magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so increase your magic resistance first.
Ekko.combo: A safe short trade is to mark the target with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, detonate it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Ekko E Phase Dive is down, hit him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain connected; when the root lands, follow with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. If you want another root, use LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and engage after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. When both movement abilities are down, approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and connect LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Ekko.fight: Avoid the range of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and trade briefly right after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and look for a chance to catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before going in, check that LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Watch which direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and move out of its return path too. If you see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not chase recklessly even at low health.

Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize Irelia. LeBlanc should not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then engage from the side. Check your escape route with LeBlanc W Distortion’s return and focus on catching one target.
Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor early, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and LeBlanc has low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. The moment the tether holds and the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark. Stay within range while the tether holds. Check that your return point is safe before engaging, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time to return.
Irelia.escape: Look for an engage window right after Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down. Close in with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, but if Irelia still has a counterattack ability ready, return immediately with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Irelia.fight: Trade briefly right after Irelia’s key abilities are down. If she has just used Irelia Q Bladesurge, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and catch her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Save LeBlanc W Distortion’s return and get out before the trade lasts too long.
Irelia.laning: When minions are about to die, step back with Irelia Q Bladesurge’s engage range in mind. Push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you have not pushed, do not leave.
Irelia.phase: Later, Irelia can counterattack if you fail to kill her in one burst, so build a lead earlier.
Irelia.watch: If a low-health minion is between you and Irelia, she can use Irelia Q Bladesurge to reach you repeatedly, so step back. Dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun, and if you are trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Lux.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and Lux is focused on your allied tank, approach from the side. Enter spread out from your allies so you do not get caught with them by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Pick a target, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, then get out. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy roaming alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding can lead into her follow-up abilities, so bait it out and engage after it misses. Lux Q Light Binding can bind up to two targets, so do not stand in a line with an ally. When you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark, dodge sideways. If you are hit by an ability, keep your distance so you do not get hit by the attack that triggers Lux P Illumination.
Lux.laning: Stand apart from your allies and to the side so you can dodge Lux Q Light Binding. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, approach from the side with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Stay within range until the tether roots her, then detonate the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice and LeBlanc W Distortion. Check that your return point is safe before going in, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Close in with LeBlanc W Distortion and catch her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, but stay within range while the tether holds. If Lux still has a counterattack ability ready, use LeBlanc W Distortion’s return to get out.
Lux.fight: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Follow LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice with LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to trade briefly and get out.
Lux.phase: Early on, build magic resistance to withstand Lux’s magic damage and take short trades. Later, avoid forced engages because it becomes harder to kill the enemy in one burst once the enemy has magic resistance and vision.

Neeko.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on, and spread out from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs doesn’t root several of you. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your frontline, pick a target from the side, engage, and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. If possible, catch an isolated enemy with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains before the team fight.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so avoid it by not standing on top of an ally. Move away when Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup is visible, and spread out before the animation appears if transformed Neeko seems to be approaching. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Neeko’s magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads. Prioritize tenacity if Neeko E Tangle-Barbs followed by Neeko R Pop Blossom is likely to kill you.
Neeko.combo: For a short trade, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down and you land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, stay within chain range and use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion as soon as the root lands.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to engage with LeBlanc W Distortion. When you go in, don’t miss LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window.
Neeko.fight: Immediately after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal brief damage, then return. Check that your return point is safe before going in, and don’t chase deeper if Neeko still has a retaliation ability available.
Neeko.laning: Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. Don’t leave lane if you haven’t pushed it.
Neeko.phase: LeBlanc has the most kill opportunities from just after learning LeBlanc R Mimic through mid game, so build a lead then. In late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder for LeBlanc to kill in one burst, so be careful when engaging.

Ryze.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, go in from the side. Pick a target, root them with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or close in with LeBlanc W Distortion to kill them, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Also look for a chance to catch an isolated enemy before a team fight.
Ryze.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: If Ryze’s key ability is down, apply the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger it, then recast W to return. If you have a clear angle to root Ryze, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain attached; when the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion.
Ryze.escape: The moment after Ryze E Spell Flux misses or Ryze W Rune Prison is used is also an opportunity to engage. Before going in, check that LeBlanc W Distortion’s return point is safe.
Ryze.fight: Trade briefly just after Ryze E Spell Flux misses or Ryze W Rune Prison is used. Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion to deal damage, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return before he can retaliate.
Ryze.laning: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him before he has items to slow his growth. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. Don’t leave lane if you haven’t pushed it.
Ryze.phase: Early on, use Ryze’s low mana and damage to pressure him. In late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder to kill in one burst, so build a lead earlier.
Ryze.watch: If you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, separate from allies until the mark disappears to avoid the amplified damage and spread from Ryze Q Overload. Once marked, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.

Vex.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. After a fight starts, engage from the side, target one enemy, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. If a low-health ally has Vex R Shadow Surge’s mark, move them out of Vex’s range first to prevent the initial takedown. If possible, catch Vex when she is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains before a team fight.
Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early on. Vex mainly deals magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Vex.combo: When the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and maintain the chain. As soon as the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return to safety. If you need an additional root, use LeBlanc R Mimic right after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic the chain.
Vex.escape: Confirm that the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has also been consumed before going in, then root her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before engaging, check that LeBlanc W Distortion’s return point is safe.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening just after the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is consumed and Vex W Personal Space is down. Use LeBlanc W Distortion to dash in briefly, deal damage, then recast it to return. Don’t engage if Vex still has a retaliation spell available.
Vex.laning: Don’t engage first with LeBlanc W Distortion while the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave.
Vex.phase: Early on, survive while avoiding the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, and look for openings to engage before Vex learns R Shadow Surge. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, a one-shot becomes harder, so first look for a chance to pick off an enemy who is alone.
Vex.watch: When the Doom part of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active, LeBlanc W Distortion’s dash can be interrupted and you can be feared, so wait until Vex consumes Doom before engaging. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so take a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies so they can help absorb Vex’s dash.

Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t gain a larger shield, and don’t stand alone at the very back along Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. LeBlanc shouldn’t engage first; wait until the enemy’s attention is on your team’s tank, then choose a target and engage from the side. After killing the target, escape with LeBlanc W Distortion, or catch an enemy who is alone with E Ethereal Chains before a team fight.
Yone.phase: Later in the game, the risk of retaliation rises if you fail to kill your target in one burst, so look for chances to pick off enemies who are alone in areas without vision.
Yone.build: Secure movement speed first so it’s easier to get out of Yone’s telegraphed attack range. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Also avoid stacking only health, considering W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.combo: After Yone engages, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the right distance to maintain the chain. If you need an additional root to stop his return, use R Mimic right after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic E Ethereal Chains.
Yone.escape: Close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado stacks have expired and mobility options such as E Soul Unbound are down. If only one mobility spell is down, he can escape with the other, so especially look for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. Don’t miss LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window when you engage.
Yone.fight: Trade briefly after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado stacks expire and his mobility spell is down. When engaging with LeBlanc W Distortion, check that the return point is safe. If Yone still has a retaliation spell available, recast W to get out. If Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains’s root.
Yone.laning: When Yone stacks Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, create distance. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, back out of range and wait for the stacks to expire. When Yone engages with E Soul Unbound, hold LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains; if you maintain the chain until the root lands, you can stop him from returning. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so don’t stand alone at the very back just before a team fight.

Fizz.phase: Early on, take advantage of Fizz E Playful / Trickster's mana cost and look for openings while it is down. In the late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder to kill in one burst and can easily counterattack, so look for chances to pick off enemies who are alone in areas without vision.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies and make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first; once it is down, focus him together. LeBlanc should not engage first from the front. After a fight starts, choose a target and approach from the side, then return with W. Also look for a chance to catch and pick off an enemy who is alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fizz's damage is mostly magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so increase your magic resistance first.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, hit him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, as the chain connects and roots him, detonate the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. Keep the right distance so the chain does not break, and return after checking that W's return point is safe. If you need another root, use LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic E.
Fizz.escape: Fizz E Playful / Trickster being down before it comes back up is an opportunity to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so do not chase deep just because one movement ability is down. Only engage if you can return within the brief window when W can be recast.
Fizz.fight: Trade damage briefly right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, and attack, but watch Fizz's remaining counterplay and use W to return and get out.
Fizz.laning: Early on, watch for Fizz E Playful / Trickster to be used, and look to trade even when Fizz W Seastone Trident's empowered attack misses a last hit. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you have not pushed, do not leave your position.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used both to engage and to escape, so save LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and your burst until it is down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters' fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts, then throw LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains along the path Fizz Q Urchin Strike would take to go in.

Karma.teamfight: Do not engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is ready or Karma R Mantra-enhanced E Inspire’s shield is active. Once a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, pick one target from the side, engage, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, look for a chance to catch an enemy roaming alone through an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: If Karma W Focused Resolve is down, mark her with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, detonate it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If you see an opening to root her, hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the tether connected. When the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion.
Karma.escape: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, use LeBlanc W Distortion’s dash or return to create distance and break the tether before it roots. The return window is short, so check your return point before going in.
Karma.fight: Right after Karma W Focused Resolve is down, use LeBlanc W Distortion to go in, deal brief damage, then recast it to return. If Karma E Inspire’s shield is active, wait for it to end, and check that your return point is safe before engaging.
Karma.laning: Move behind minions or out of range so taking free poke does not let Karma recharge R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave.
Karma.phase: Early on, build resistance to withstand Karma’s magic damage, and take only short trades when her key abilities are down. Later, avoid forced frontal engages because it becomes harder to kill her in one burst once the enemy has magic resistance and vision.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame can slow multiple enemies, so avoid being hit. If you are caught in the zone left by Karma R Mantra-enhanced Q, get outside the circle before it detonates. Karma W Focused Resolve roots you if the tether holds, so create distance as soon as it connects to break it. Delay your engage while Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed are active.

Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas goes in with E Abscond / Abduct, root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or R Mimic and kill him before he can heal with W Kingslayer. When engaging directly, wait until the fight starts, target a backliner from the side, and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Also look for a chance to catch an isolated enemy in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Sylas.build: Early on, withstand his damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Sylas.combo: When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain attached; as soon as the root lands, trigger the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. Check that your return point is safe before engaging and recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time to return.
Sylas.escape: After dodging the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, that ability being down is your chance to engage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is also available, he can escape with another movement tool, so watch for it as you go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Escape before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window ends.
Sylas.fight: Trade briefly after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is used and before it comes back up. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, but watch whether Sylas W Kingslayer is still available and escape using LeBlanc W Distortion’s return.
Sylas.laning: Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave, then roam. Don’t leave lane if you haven’t pushed it.
Sylas.phase: In late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder to kill in one burst, so avoid forcing an engage.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chains thrown after the first dash are the dangerous part. Use LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge those chains, and move away immediately from the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash. A low-health Sylas can heal a lot with W Kingslayer, so don’t delay finishing him off.

Viktor.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. Wait until Viktor’s attention is on your team’s tank, then approach from the side. Avoid Viktor W Gravity Field’s area, target a backliner, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a team fight, also look for a chance to catch Viktor when he is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Viktor.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early on. Viktor mainly deals magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: If Viktor W Gravity Field is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and maintain the chain. As soon as the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Check that the return point is safe before going in, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash, so close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion when Viktor W Gravity Field is down. After engaging, don’t stay in W Gravity Field’s area. If Viktor still has a retaliation spell available, recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return.
Viktor.fight: Trade briefly just after Viktor E Hextech Ray or Viktor W Gravity Field is down. Close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal damage, check what retaliation spells he has left, then recast W to get out.
Viktor.laning: Pressure Viktor early, before he builds up P Glorious Evolution stacks. Push the lane while dodging Viktor E Hextech Ray’s poke, then clear the wave and join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle.
Viktor.phase: Look for chances to pressure Viktor with LeBlanc early, before he builds up stacks. Later, Viktor becomes stronger, and if LeBlanc can’t kill him in one burst, she can easily be punished, so avoid forcing an engage.
Viktor.watch: To dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, don’t stand in line with the wave; stand off to the side. Leave the area as soon as Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, and don’t continue trading where Viktor R Arcane Storm is active.

Zed.phase: Early on, build armor early and keep trades short so Zed doesn’t get ahead. Later, Zed becomes weaker, but LeBlanc also has a harder time assassinating enemies once they have magic resistance and vision, so group with your allies and don’t give Zed an isolated target.
Zed.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. When a fight starts and the enemy’s attention is on your team’s tank, target one backliner from the side. Choose a target, engage, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a team fight, first look for a chance to catch and pick off an enemy who is alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots early on. Zed’s main damage is physical, and LeBlanc has low armor, so build armor first. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor won’t block it.
Zed.combo: If you need an additional root, use LeBlanc R Mimic right after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic the chain.
Zed.escape: Just after Zed W Living Shadow is down, you have an opening to engage when the shadow disappears or Zed has already switched positions. If Zed R Death Mark is also down and before it comes back up, close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion and catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If only one of Zed’s mobility spells is down, he can escape with the remaining one, so don’t rush the engage.
Zed.fight: Trade briefly after Zed W Living Shadow is down and the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched positions. Engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, trigger LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark with another ability, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return before he can retaliate. Check that the return point is safe before going in.
Zed.laning: Early on, withstand one of Zed’s combos with Cloth Armor and only trade just after his key abilities are down. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave.
Zed.watch: Track the position of Zed W Living Shadow. Zed E Shadow Slash slows you if it hits from a shadow, so move out of its area. If Zed R Death Mark is on you, bind Zed with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to interrupt his combo for stacking additional damage.

Ahri.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Most of Ahri's damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.teamfight: Don't engage first from the front. Wait for the fight to start and for Ahri to focus on your allied tank. Then engage from the side after Ahri E Charm is down, kill your target, and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Ahri.combo: If Ahri E Charm is down, mark her with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger it, then recast W to return. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits, stay within range to keep the chain attached and use Q → W when the root lands.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm is also down, it is a good time to engage and look for a chance to bind her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Ahri.fight: Look for a short trade right after Ahri E Charm is down. Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal damage, then return while watching for Ahri's remaining counterplay.
Ahri.laning: Move with the minion wave between you and Ahri to avoid Ahri E Charm. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push, then join a side-lane or jungle skirmish.
Ahri.phase: Early on, before Ahri learns R Spirit Rush, LeBlanc has an opening to engage. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, it becomes harder to kill a target in one burst, so look for chances to pick off isolated targets.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm, since getting hit can leave you taking her full follow-up combo. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its way back, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Ambessa.fight: Trade briefly right after Ambessa uses her abilities and spends the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check that the return point is safe. If you see the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, don't attack; back off.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa spends her abilities, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. When the chain stays attached and the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. If you engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, don't miss the window to return. When you need to extend the root, cast LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic E.
Ambessa.teamfight: Don't engage first from the front, and don't stand with your allied backline in the path of Ambessa R Public Execution. Once the fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, target one enemy in the backline from the side and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for chances to bind and pick off enemies moving alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Ambessa.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Most of Ambessa's damage is physical, so prioritize armor.
Ambessa.escape: Don't go in first with LeBlanc W Distortion while Ambessa E Lacerate's slow and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step dash are still available. Engage right after Ambessa spends her abilities and charges; if she still has a counterattack ability, return immediately by recasting LeBlanc W Distortion.
Ambessa.laning: Push the lane with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then join a side-lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the wave, don't leave your lane.
Ambessa.phase: Later, if LeBlanc can't kill a target in one burst, she becomes vulnerable to retaliation, so build a lead earlier.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and move out of range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, escape immediately with LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge the blade tips of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. When posturing, don't stand at the end of the straight line targeted by Ambessa R Public Execution.

AurelionSol.teamfight: Don't engage first from the front. Wait until the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then engage from the side and target one enemy in the backline. Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion after engaging.
AurelionSol.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.combo: Once Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, move beside him with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down is your window to engage. Before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check that the return point is safe; if Aurelion Sol still has a counterattack ability, trade briefly and then return.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Find an angle to bind him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, deal brief damage, then escape by returning with LeBlanc W Distortion.
AurelionSol.laning: Pressure Aurelion Sol early, but don't take unnecessary hits from Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and give him Stardust. When you can push, clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then join a side-lane or jungle skirmish.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, pressure Aurelion Sol aggressively while he has little Stardust. Later, as he builds Stardust, it becomes harder to kill him from the same angle, so avoid forced frontal fights.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health and builds Stardust if it hits you for too long, so stay behind minions and get out of its targeting line quickly. If your health is low, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity's area to avoid being executed. After he has built Stardust, Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend can knock up multiple enemies and create a shockwave, so spread out from allies.

Corki.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then approach from the side. Pick one backliner to target and take them out, then get out with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch Corki alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, so increase your armor first. Corki P Hextech Munitions' true damage cannot be blocked by resistances, and while Corki E Gatling Gun is hitting you, the effect of your increased resistances is also reduced.
Corki.combo: When Corki W Valkyrie is down, approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Do not miss the window to return with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Corki.escape: Right after you make Corki use Corki W Valkyrie, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain if you approach recklessly, so hold off on engaging until then.
Corki.fight: Corki using Corki W Valkyrie creates an opportunity to engage. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to deal brief damage. Before going in, check that LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe, and get out while you can still return.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki's farming during the first five levels. Do not trade while taking Corki E Gatling Gun head-on; trade briefly after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle.
Corki.phase: Pressure Corki, whose base stats are low, during the first five levels to stunt his growth. In the late game, Corki can build items and fire missiles from a safe position, so do not give him time to farm comfortably.
Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move aside instead of standing your ground in front of him. Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around the first target it strikes, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition so you are not hit by the third missile repeatedly.

Kassadin.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, target one enemy from the side, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk’s engage range later in the game, and, if possible, look for a chance to catch an enemy roaming alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains before a teamfight.
Kassadin.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance.
Kassadin.combo: For a short trade, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark → recast W. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down and you have a chance to catch him, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Keep the tether connected until the root lands, then deal damage with Q → W.
Kassadin.escape: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have a window to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is down too, you have less reason to worry about its slow, but check that W’s return point is safe before engaging.
Kassadin.fight: If Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, mark him with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, detonate it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast W to get out.
Kassadin.laning: Avoid unnecessary ability use so you do not help reduce Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, and clear the wave outside Kassadin’s range when possible. Push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish.
Kassadin.phase: Later, Kassadin can use Kassadin R Riftwalk to get into your backline and escape, so do not stand alone within its range.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs LeBlanc’s magic poke, so look for an opening while Q is down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, and Kassadin R Riftwalk is used to engage and disengage, so do not go deep while both abilities are ready.

Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are on the field, clear them first with LeBlanc W Distortion’s area damage and look for an opening to engage. Do not engage first from the front. Once a fight starts, pick one target from the side, attack, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, prioritize chances to catch an enemy roaming alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Malzahar.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Malzahar.combo: Remove Malzahar P Void Shift first, then use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark and recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If you hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, stay within range to keep the tether connected. The moment it roots him, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. If you need another root with LeBlanc R Mimic, use LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains immediately beforehand.
Malzahar.escape: Right after Malzahar Q Call of the Void’s silence is down, you have a chance to close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Malzahar has no ability to create distance, so follow your engage with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to catch him. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, do not go in alone, and check that LeBlanc W Distortion’s return point is safe before engaging.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, damage and crowd control are less effective, so remove it first with an ability such as LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Right after Malzahar’s key abilities are down, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal brief damage, then recast it to return. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are already out, clear them first with an area-of-effect ability.
Malzahar.laning: Avoid standing beside minions in a wave afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and step back until it clears. Early on, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and pressure Malzahar, leaving him less room to stack Malzahar W Void Swarm. If Malzahar has pushed the lane, call your jungler and go in together after removing Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.phase: Push and pressure the lane early so Malzahar has less room to stack Malzahar W Void Swarm. Malzahar gets stronger over time, while LeBlanc is vulnerable to a counterattack if she fails to kill someone in one burst, so build a lead earlier.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect jumps to a nearby enemy, so do not go for a last hit beside that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the doorway and delay your engage until you avoid the silence. Malzahar R Nether Grasp cannot be cleansed with LeBlanc W Distortion or a shield, so do not pass through an area without vision alone while it is available.

Orianna.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, approach from the side and pick a target. Orianna W Command: Dissonance, Orianna E Command: Protect, and Orianna R Command: Shockwave can help her retaliate, so keep LeBlanc W Distortion’s return in mind as you escape. Before a team fight, look for a chance to catch an isolated enemy in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Orianna.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Orianna deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Orianna.combo: For a short trade, apply the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast W to return. If you can reliably root Orianna while avoiding her retaliation, keep LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains attached and use Q → W as soon as the root lands.
Orianna.escape: Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion when Orianna has sent her ball away with Orianna Q Command: Attack and has difficulty using retaliation tools like Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Orianna has no movement ability of her own, so close the gap and keep LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains attached to look for a root, but check that W’s return point is safe before going in.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her is your chance to fight without her armor and magic resistance increase. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal brief damage, and recast W to return if Orianna still has a retaliation ability available.
Orianna.laning: Orianna is weak early, but repeated basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup hurt, so pressure her with abilities instead of trading basic attacks. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. Don’t leave lane if you haven’t pushed it.
Orianna.phase: In late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder to kill in one burst, so avoid forcing an engage.
Orianna.watch: Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in around where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball, so watch the ball and position accordingly. Orianna W Command: Dissonance’s slow and Orianna E Command: Protect’s shield can also help her retaliate, so check whether she still has them before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion.

Syndra.laning: Don’t force an engage while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available, and move to avoid the line of her spheres. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish.
Syndra.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on, and avoid areas where Syndra has several Syndra Q Dark Spheres. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, pick a target from the side, engage, and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a team fight, look for a chance to catch an isolated enemy in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Syndra.build: Early on, build magic resistance first with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Syndra W Force of Will’s true damage can’t be reduced with magic resistance, so keep your total health in mind too.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep at the right distance to maintain the chain.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Check that your return point is safe before engaging, and if Syndra still has a retaliation ability available, escape within LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window.
Syndra.fight: Just after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion for a short trade. Walk to dodge where Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will land, and keep LeBlanc W Distortion’s return available so you can escape before she retaliates.
Syndra.phase: Early on, dodge Syndra’s abilities and build magic resistance and movement speed. In late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision make LeBlanc’s assassinations harder, so avoid forcing an engage.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, she can push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra R Unleashed Power deals more damage in areas with several Syndra Q Dark Spheres, so avoid those areas and watch for an execute when your health is low.

Vladimir.teamfight: Don’t group with your allies inside Vladimir R Hemoplague’s area, and retreat until the effect ends if you’re infected. Once a fight starts and the enemy’s attention is on your team’s tank, target one enemy from the side, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. If possible, catch an enemy who is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains before a team fight to create an objective opportunity.
Vladimir.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing makes duels drag on, consider anti-heal after getting resistances.
Vladimir.combo: Make Vladimir use W Sanguine Pool first, then hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains as the pool ends. Return to a safe point before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window expires.
Vladimir.escape: When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, engage with LeBlanc W Distortion. As the pool ends, you have a chance to catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic. The moment Vladimir slows himself while charging E Tides of Blood is also a chance to close the distance.
Vladimir.fight: Trade briefly just after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down. Close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to look for a root, then recast W to return. Check that the return point is safe before going in.
Vladimir.laning: When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you to block the wave or move out of range. Push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you can’t push it, don’t leave.
Vladimir.phase: Later in the game, Vladimir may scale and LeBlanc may have fewer chances to kill him in one burst, so build a lead earlier.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and, when empowered, also increases his movement speed, so don’t trade while taking an empowered Q. When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charged, put minions between you or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague infects you, you take increased damage, so retreat until the effect ends.

Akali.teamfight: Don't engage first from the front. Wait until the fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then engage from the side. Choose a target in the backline and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, first look for a chance to bind and pick off an enemy moving alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Akali.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali's main damage is magic and LeBlanc has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Akali tends to have high magic resistance, so consider penetration when increasing your damage.
Akali.combo: The most reliable sequence is to hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, then, when the chain stays attached and the root lands, use Q Sigil of Malice → W Distortion to trigger the mark. If you engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, return during the brief window when you can recast it. To try for another root, cast R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic E.
Akali.escape: If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip is down, account for the remaining mobility before engaging. If both are down, especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, go in with LeBlanc W Distortion and look for LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If Akali still has a counterattack ability, escape by returning with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Akali.fight: Trade briefly after Akali W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip are down. Especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, look for a chance to close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and bind her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and R Mimic. Before going in, make sure LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe.
Akali.laning: Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push, then join a side-lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the wave, don't leave your lane.
Akali.phase: Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, it becomes harder to kill a target in one burst, so use your earlier lead to look for picks.
Akali.watch: Watch for Akali to turn invisible in Akali W Twilight Shroud, but track her movement with the true sight granted when LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits.

Aurora.teamfight: Don't engage first from the front; wait until the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then choose a target and engage from the side. If Aurora jumps in but gets no takedown, look for a chance to bind her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If an ally is killed, Aurora's jump cooldown resets, so don't leave a low-health ally behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora's mobility ability is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, when the chain stays attached and the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Keep the right distance so the chain doesn't break and leave time to recast LeBlanc W Distortion. If you need another root, cast LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic E.
Aurora.escape: Don't engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil alone is down. She can also escape with Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora R Between Worlds, so look especially for the window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. During that window, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains; only go in if you can escape with the return.
Aurora.fight: Trade briefly only right after Aurora's key abilities are down. Before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check that the return point is safe; if Aurora still has a counterattack ability, return immediately. While Aurora W Across the Veil has her invisible, don't rush to use a targeted ability; wait until she reappears.
Aurora.laning: Early on, build magic resistance and avoid forced trades. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push, then join a side-lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the wave, don't leave your lane.
Aurora.phase: Early on, survive with Aurora's magic damage and LeBlanc's low magic resistance in mind. Later, the enemy's magic resistance and vision make it harder to kill a target in one burst, so look for picks instead of forced engages.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, its recast deals a second hit when the curse returns, so move out of the line between Aurora and yourself. The lower your health, the more damage the return deals, so don't stay under the curse; escape by returning with LeBlanc W Distortion. Once Aurora R Between Worlds creates its zone, you are slowed when leaving it, so retreat before the zone appears.

Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several people are not pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and use vision to check Diana's flank routes. LeBlanc should not engage first; wait until a fight starts, then approach from the side and target one backliner. After a kill, use LeBlanc W Distortion to get out. Before a teamfight, look for a chance to pick off an enemy who is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Diana.build: Diana's damage is mostly magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so increase your magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.combo: When Diana E Lunar Rush is down, hit her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the right distance for the root to connect.
Diana.escape: If Diana goes in first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark, catch her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains while she has no movement ability to escape. Right after Diana E Lunar Rush is down, you can also close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marked you, create distance rather than fighting with the possibility of her re-engaging in mind.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike, then trade briefly after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down. Before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check for a safe return point. If her counterattack is still available, recast it to get out.
Diana.laning: Afterward, clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice and roam. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave your position.
Diana.phase: In the late game, if enemies have magic resistance and vision, it becomes harder to kill them in one burst, so avoid risky engages.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels, so dodge sideways instead of only moving backward. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can bring her back in, so immediately create distance. Do not approach right after Diana W Pale Cascade is activated. In teamfights, spread out so several people are not pulled in by Diana R Moonfall.

Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, do not start a small skirmish against Galio's team in another lane. When a teamfight starts, do not engage first from the front. Wait until the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then target one backliner from the side and get out with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Galio.build: Galio's damage is mostly magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so increase your magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Galio.combo: If Galio's key abilities are down, hit him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, as the chain connects and roots him, detonate the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. Return to a safe position before the window to return with LeBlanc W Distortion ends.
Galio.escape: Do not go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; look for a window before Galio R Hero's Entrance is back up as well. If Galio W Shield of Durand is also down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Galio.fight: Trade damage briefly right after Galio W Shield of Durand or Galio E Justice Punch is down. Before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion, check that the return point is safe, watch for any counterattack abilities he has left, and return right away.
Galio.laning: Galio is melee and uses a lot of mana, so poke him from range and make him use his abilities to clear the wave. Once Galio is low on mana, push the lane with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice. After pushing, join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle.
Galio.phase: Pressure Galio early by taking advantage of his melee range, and use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand his magic damage. In the late game, avoid risky engages because enemies with magic resistance and vision are harder to kill in one burst.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, the damage he takes is reduced and the taunt lasts longer, so do not commit your damage; walk out of range. Dodge when you see the windup of Galio E Justice Punch, which moves him backward, and immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.

Lissandra.laning: Farm at an angle to your allied minions that avoids Lissandra Q Ice Shard’s pierce path. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting an allied minion, so do not stand in a line with minions. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb catches you, you can take her full damage, so do not force your way in with LeBlanc W Distortion while either ability is ready. If Lissandra uses Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she avoids damage, so finish her after the stasis ends.
Lissandra.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then go in from the side. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, pick one target, catch them with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or deal damage, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is ready, do not put all your damage into Lissandra at once.
Lissandra.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lissandra.combo: If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is down too, hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the tether connected. The moment it roots her, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. If you need another root, cast LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic the chain.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is used, you have a chance to close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. While the claw is traveling, root her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to prevent her from recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path to dash to it. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down too, engage during this window when the risk of being caught and counterattacked is lower.
Lissandra.fight: Trade briefly right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Go in with LeBlanc W Distortion and deal damage. If Lissandra still has a counterattack ability ready, recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is down too, look for a chance to catch her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Lissandra.phase: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and trade briefly only when Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, it becomes harder for LeBlanc to kill someone in one burst, so look for picks instead of engaging from the front.

Mel.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, target one enemy in the backline from the side. Check whether Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare have been used, engage, attack, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, first look for a chance to catch an enemy roaming alone through an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Mel.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Mel deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. When the tether roots her, attack with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. Stay within range while the tether holds, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return after engaging. If you need another root, plan your ability order so you can use LeBlanc R Mimic to mimic LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so go in with LeBlanc W Distortion when Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down.
Mel.fight: Trade briefly right after Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare are down. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and attack, then recast to return to a safe spot if Mel still has a counterattack ability ready. Check that your return point is safe before engaging.
Mel.laning: Mel has no mobility ability, so look for chances to close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion from early on. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave.
Mel.phase: Push and pressure the lane early so Mel has no room to grow. The growth Mel gains from Mel R Golden Eclipse is permanent, putting you at a disadvantage as time passes, so do not delay fighting until late game.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you are hit by its center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow up, so dodge to the side. Do not throw LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains while Mel W Rebuttal is active.

Qiyana.phase: Early on, withstand Qiyana’s physical damage with Cloth Armor and don’t give up an advantage. Qiyana is relatively weaker late, but LeBlanc is also vulnerable to retaliation if she can’t kill her target in one burst, so move with your team.
Qiyana.teamfight: Avoid the river and narrow passages, and even when standing with allies, don’t give Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent an angle to hit terrain. LeBlanc shouldn’t engage first; once the enemy focuses on your allied tank, target a backliner from the side. If you engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, escape with its return, and look for a chance to catch an isolated enemy with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains before a team fight.
Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with the river element, move out of range of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears while holding the brush element, move into allied vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Qiyana’s primary physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. Don’t build magic resistance specifically for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape.
Qiyana.combo: Before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Keep the chain attached, then trigger the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion as soon as the root lands. Return before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window ends.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don’t rush your engage. Your chance to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion comes after both movement abilities are down and you dodge the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If Qiyana still has a retaliation ability available, escape using LeBlanc W Distortion’s return.
Qiyana.fight: Right after avoiding Qiyana’s combo, check whether Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down before fighting. Go in briefly with LeBlanc W Distortion to deal damage, then recast it to return. Check that your return point is safe before going in.
Qiyana.laning: Watch which element Qiyana is holding in an open area away from walls and brush. Trade briefly when she uses an ability and remains in front of you. Use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to clear the wave and push the lane before roaming; don’t leave if you haven’t pushed it.

Xerath.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. Wait until a fight starts and Xerath’s attention is on your team’s tank, then engage from the side. Pick one backliner and attack, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a team fight, also look for a chance to catch and pick off an enemy who is alone in an area where you have no vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early on. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: If Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and maintain the chain. As soon as the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. The mark must be triggered by a subsequent ability. After the trade, recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility spell, so engage with LeBlanc W Distortion while Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. If Xerath E Shocking Orb is still available, wait to engage because you can be stunned. Don’t go in if your return point is dangerous or you can’t make it back before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window ends.
Xerath.fight: Just after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion. Deal brief damage, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. Check that the return point is safe before going in.
Xerath.laning: Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you even behind minions, so close the distance while sidestepping as he starts charging it. Farm while avoiding his heavy damage and wait for Xerath to run low on mana. Then clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, and call your jungler or join a skirmish.
Xerath.phase: Early on, farm while avoiding the heavy damage from Xerath’s long range. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, a one-shot becomes harder, so avoid forcing an engage.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you’re vulnerable to follow-up damage, so don’t rush in with LeBlanc W Distortion while he still has it available. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so take a wide sidestep when you see him charging it. Start dodging immediately when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation.

Zoe.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. Once a fight starts and the enemy’s attention is on your team’s tank, approach Zoe from the side. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close in with LeBlanc W Distortion, kill one target, then return. Before a team fight, also look for a chance to catch and pick off Zoe when she is alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits, it puts you to sleep after a delay, leaving you vulnerable to heavy damage from Zoe Q Paddle Star! at that moment. Dodge the bubble as it flies toward you. If it hits, move behind a wall or ally before the sleep takes effect, out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s angle. A bubble that misses also leaves a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and brush entrances.
Zoe.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early on. Zoe mainly deals magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. However, resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and maintain the chain. As soon as the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Check that the return point is safe before using LeBlanc W Distortion, and return within its brief return window. If you need an additional root, use LeBlanc R Mimic right after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to mimic the chain.
Zoe.escape: Just after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, you have an opening to engage with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Zoe moves with R Portal Jump, target the spot where she’ll return.
Zoe.fight: Just after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, deal brief damage, then return. If you see Zoe preparing to throw Q Paddle Star!, look for a chance to disrupt her re-aiming with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, target the spot where she started.
Zoe.laning: Early on, build magic resistance and only trade briefly after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave. Near Zoe, save nonessential summoner spells and active items so you don’t give her a shard.
Zoe.phase: Early on, survive with LeBlanc’s Null-Magic Mantle and look for an opening when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, a one-shot becomes harder, so avoid forcing an engage.

Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, while LeBlanc is vulnerable to a counterattack if she cannot kill her target in one burst, so look for chances to pick off enemies who are alone in the late game.
Azir.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, then approach from the side and target one backliner. Do not enter together in a narrow corridor where Azir R Emperor's Divide could knock you back as a group. In areas without vision, also look for a chance to catch an enemy who is alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Azir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to increase your magic resistance early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. LeBlanc's magic damage is effective against Azir, who has low magic resistance, so invest first in surviving.
Azir.combo: If Azir E Shifting Sands is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay at the right distance to keep the chain connected. If you need another root, use LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Azir.escape: Azir using Azir E Shifting Sands creates an opening to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, you can be knocked back, so check his counterattack abilities and make sure LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe before going in. Do not miss the brief window to return.
Azir.fight: After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers, attack briefly while they are stopped. If Azir E Shifting Sands is also down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Do not trade for long; return with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Azir.laning: After clearing the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you have not pushed the lane, do not leave your position.
Azir.watch: If you stand too long in the attack line of Azir W Arise! soldiers, they will keep damaging you, so circle around to approach Azir himself. Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers and slows you; look for an opening while they are stopped after he uses it. In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back several people, so do not enter together there.

Hwei.phase: Build magic resistance early to withstand Hwei's magic damage, and trade briefly. In the late game, enemies with magic resistance and vision can counterattack if you fail to kill them in one burst, so prioritize chances to pick them off.
Hwei.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. When a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, approach from the side. When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, go in on one backline target with LeBlanc W Distortion, then return with W. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy who is alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Hwei.combo: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, hit him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the right distance to maintain the chain.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no movement ability, so engage with LeBlanc W Distortion during a window when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If E is still available, he can interrupt your engage or root you, so wait. Before going in, check that W's return point is safe.
Hwei.fight: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Deal brief damage, check Hwei's remaining counterattack abilities, and get out with W.
Hwei.laning: Do not go in first with LeBlanc W Distortion while Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle. If you have not pushed, do not leave your position.
Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can root or displace you, making you vulnerable to follow-up damage. If the first ability hits you, immediately reposition with LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge the second. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so leave its telegraphed area.

Naafiri.phase: Early on, use LeBlanc’s range advantage to poke Naafiri. Later, a counterattack is dangerous if LeBlanc fails to kill someone in one burst, so prioritize chances to catch an enemy roaming alone.
Naafiri.teamfight: Do not engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy is focused on your allied tank, pick a target and engage from the side. Target one enemy in the backline and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Watch for Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit, avoid roaming alone away from your allies, and retreat right after an ally dies so you are not picked off next.
Naafiri.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first and get health as well. If the fight drags on because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate heal her, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Naafiri.combo: Then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return to a safe spot.
Naafiri.escape: Engage during the window when Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down and Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is not available yet. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and block her escape route with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
