If Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is still ready, retreat within the short window when you can use LeBlanc W Distortion’s return.
Naafiri.fight: Trade briefly only right after Naafiri’s key mobility ability is down. Mark her with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, detonate it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return before she can counterattack. Check that your return point is safe before engaging.
Naafiri.laning: Naafiri is melee, so farm and poke from behind the minion line. Do not give her an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. After Naafiri E Eviscerate, which revives the pack, is down, look for a chance to clear the pack with LeBlanc W Distortion’s area damage. If you have pushed the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, join a side lane or jungle skirmish.
Naafiri.watch: If you are hit by one of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, create distance until the bleed ends so you do not get hit by the second dagger. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she cannot be targeted, so use your finishing ability after it ends. Do not roam alone while Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is ready.

Talon.teamfight: Instead of engaging head-on, look for a chance to root Talon with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and LeBlanc R Mimic when he dives into your backline. If you can pick off a target first, use LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to catch an isolated enemy in an area without vision.
Talon.build: Early on, withstand his damage with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first against Talon’s damage, but build health as well once he gets lethality. Talon tends to have high magic resistance, so include penetration when increasing your damage.
Talon.combo: When Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep at the right distance to maintain the chain.
Talon.escape: The moment after you make Talon use Q Noxian Diplomacy is your window to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Check that your return point is safe before engaging, and if Talon still has a retaliation ability available, escape before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window ends.
Talon.fight: Just after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion for a short trade. If Talon still has a retaliation ability available, recast LeBlanc W Distortion to escape, and avoid engages with no way back.
Talon.laning: Push the wave to limit Talon’s roams. If he leaves lane, share his location and place vision along jungle paths. LeBlanc should also join skirmishes only after pushing the lane.
Talon.phase: In late game, LeBlanc’s assassinations become harder and Talon’s impact also falls off, so group up and withstand his engage.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on both its outward and return paths, Talon P Blade’s End stacks build up, so move out of its return path if you take the first hit. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.

Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t go in first from the front. Once the fight starts and the enemy’s attention is on your allied tank, pick one target and engage from the side. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is positioned to block your key abilities, change your angle or wait for it to disappear. If possible, before a team fight, catch an enemy wandering alone without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Yasuo.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.combo: After removing the shield and Yasuo’s tornado is down, hit with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay within chain range until the root takes hold. If you need an additional root, use LeBlanc R Mimic to copy the most recently used LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws his Q Steel Tempest tornado is an opening to engage. Don’t go in just because only Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down. Use LeBlanc W Distortion to close the gap when you can layer crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Then bind him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and leave time to return.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start trading. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so use LeBlanc W Distortion to go in, hit briefly, then recast it to return. Before going in, make sure your return point is safe.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the lane so a thin wave is pushed toward your side, reducing the number of footholds for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When roaming, clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you haven’t pushed the lane, don’t leave.
Yasuo.phase: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and trade briefly only when Yasuo’s shield and tornado are down. In the late game, it becomes harder to kill the enemy in one go once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, so avoid forcing an engage.
Yasuo.watch: If Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits you twice in a row, his next attack knocks you up with a tornado. When you see the stack effect, move out of its line and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, so don’t give up distance easily where there are lots of minions. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is still up, find an angle around it before using key abilities or wait for it to disappear.

Veigar.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front first. Wait until a fight starts and Veigar’s attention is on your team’s tank, then approach from the side. Check whether Veigar has used E Event Horizon, target one backliner, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Veigar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early on. Veigar’s main damage is magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Veigar.combo: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, mark him with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, engage with LeBlanc W Distortion, trigger the mark, then recast W to return. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits, keep the right distance to maintain the chain, then use Q → W as soon as the root lands.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility spell to create distance, so use LeBlanc W Distortion to engage while Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Check that W’s return point is safe before going in, and don’t miss its brief return window.
Veigar.fight: Trade briefly just after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Close the distance with LeBlanc W Distortion, attack, then recast W to return before Veigar can retaliate.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike only passes through the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid unnecessary hits. Push the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then join a skirmish in a side lane or the jungle.
Veigar.phase: Later in the game, Veigar’s stacks make him harder to catch with the same approach, so check his position and whether he has used E Event Horizon before fighting over an objective.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, move around within it instead of running into the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where it will land, so dodge to the side. If you’re below half health, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Annie.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie's damage is mostly magic, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: If you can bind her reliably, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and, when the chain stays attached and the root lands, attack in the order LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. The mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice must be triggered by another ability. After the trade, recast LeBlanc W Distortion before the window to return closes.
Annie.escape: Once Annie P Pyromania's stun is spent, you have a window to engage. Annie has no mobility ability, so approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, keeping close enough to maintain the chain. If Annie still has a counterattack ability, return with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Annie.fight: Trade briefly right after Annie P Pyromania's stun is down. Annie has no mobility ability, so close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and look for a chance to bind her with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before going in, make sure LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe.
Annie.laning: While Annie P Pyromania's stun is primed, wait for an opportunity outside her range. Pressure her once the stun is spent, then push the lane and join a side-lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the wave, don't leave your lane.
Annie.phase: Early on, prepare to withstand Annie's magic damage and trade only when her stun is down. Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, it becomes harder to kill a target in one burst, so avoid forced engages.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania is primed to stun, white light swirls around Annie. During that time, stay outside her ability range. After being hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, don't stay in place; create distance from Tibbers.

TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: If Twisted Fate has used his gold card, apply the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with W Distortion, then recast W to return. If you land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, keep at the right distance to maintain the chain; when the root lands, use Q Sigil of Malice → W Distortion.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is your chance to go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Watch for his retaliation and escape immediately so you don’t miss LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window.
